# External implementations (not versioned)

Shallow clones of third-party implementations of selected models, used only as a
reference for re-implementation and for comparing results. Contents are ignored by git;
`docs/research/implementations.md` records the repository URL, licence and the exact
commit of each clone.

Rules: read-only reference; do not copy code into ca-geo without checking licence
compatibility; do not run build scripts from here without review.
